scripts.text:
[Bearded Man]
Beards! Get your wonderful beards!
Would you like a beard?
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子男子]
鬍子！漂亮的鬍子，快來買呀！
想要一副嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I'd like some facial hair!
scripts.translation: 想，我也要長鬍子！

scripts.text: No thanks, thats gross!
scripts.translation: 不要，太噁心了！

scripts.text:
[Bearded Man]
HoHo~ So you want some whiskers.
Well I would give you my beards but there not cheap.
Matter of fact I have only one left...
but I'm not selling it.
But don't get mad! I can make you one.
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子男子]
呵呵~原來你也想留鬍子。
我倒是可以賣給你，不過可不便宜。
其實，我只剩最後一副了...而且不打算賣。
別生氣！我可以另做一副給你。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Man]
I would need some ^8080FFThread^000000 for the Beard.
Talk to my friend in Izlude for some ^8080FFThread^000000.
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子男子]
做鬍子需要一些^8080FF線材^000000。
去依斯魯得島找我的朋友要些^8080FF線材^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Man]
Also I would need you to get me some things for the beard.
They are:
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子男子]
此外，我還需要你幫我收集一些製作鬍子的材料。
它們分別是：

scripts.text:
^8080FFElastic Band^000000
^8080FF5 Animal Skins^000000
^8080FFBlack Dye Stuff^000000
^8080FFGranpa Beard^000000
^8080FF100 sticky Mucus^000000
^8080FFCounteragent^000000
 and one ^8080FF2 Carat Diamond^000000

[Bearded Man]
Fine, be that way!
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子男子]
好吧，那就隨你吧！

scripts.text:
[Bearded Man]
Sorry, I can only make one per person.
We don't want too many beards now. Right?
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子男子]
抱歉，每個人只能做一副。
我們不希望有太多鬍子，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Bearded Man]
Let's make you your beard!
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子男子]
這就給你做鬍子！

scripts.text: ^8080FF~You see him cutting and sewing the beard together~^000000
scripts.translation: ^8080FF~你看著他裁剪並縫合鬍子~^000000

scripts.text: ^8080FF~He hands you the finished beard~^000000
scripts.translation: ^8080FF~他把做好的鬍子遞給你~^000000

scripts.text:
[Bearded Man]
Have a nice day!
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子男子]
祝你愉快！

scripts.text:
[Bearded Man]
What the hell! I can't make a beard without the items!
Here is the list again:
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子男子]
天哪！沒有材料我怎麼做鬍子啊！
這是材料清單：

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
Good evening! I am the Master Tailor!
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
晚上好！我是裁縫大師！

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
What? A Bearded Man sent you...
Well I'm sorry to say that I am out of ^8080FFThread^000000.
But I have the address to where I get the shipments.
It is in Al de Baran Kafra Inc. warehouse area.
The address is: Al de Baran 59, 221
See you later.
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
什麼？大鬍子男子讓你來的...
抱歉，我的^8080FF線材^000000用完了。
不過，我可以告訴你進貨地址，在艾爾帕蘭卡普拉公司的倉庫區。
地址：艾爾帕蘭 59, 221
回頭見。

scripts.text: [Kafra Clerk]
scripts.translation: [卡普拉 職員]

scripts.text:
[Kafra Clerk]
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: What's in the boxes?
scripts.translation: 箱子裡有什麼？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Kafra Clerk]
They're empty.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
它們是空的。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Clerk]
Sorry but we have not received any ^8080FFThread^000000.
Our shipments have been put off until its safe.
You see we get our ^8080FFThread^000000 from Alberta and a monsters keeps attacking our merchants.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
抱歉，我們還沒有收到任何^8080FF線材^000000。
為了安全起見，我們的運輸已經暫停了。
您看，我們的^8080FF線材^000000是從艾爾貝塔運來的，但一直有魔物襲擊我們的商人。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Clerk]
Now this monsters has not been doing this before.
It may have to do with the warmer months.
Please help us out!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
這隻魔物以前可沒這麼做過。
也許是因為天氣變暖的緣故。
請幫幫我們吧！

scripts.text: [Kafra Clerk]
scripts.translation: [卡普拉 職員]

scripts.text: Oh by the way, that Thread Merchant is somewhere around Alberta 60 and 100...
scripts.translation: 對了，線材商人大概在艾爾貝塔的60, 100附近...

scripts.text: Thank You!
scripts.translation: 謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
ARGGG!! I can never get my stuff to Al de Baran!
I keep getting mobbed by some bugs.
They steal all my supplies and ^8080FFThread^000000.
scripts.translation:
[線材商人]
啊——！！我的貨永遠也送不到艾爾帕蘭了！
我老是遭到一群蟲子的圍攻。
它們偷走了我所有的補給品和^8080FF線材^000000。

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
What am I to do?
scripts.translation:
[線材商人]
我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text: [Thread Merchant]
scripts.translation: [線材商人]

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
What am I to do?
Kill! Kill them already!!!
scripts.translation:
[線材商人]
我該怎麼辦？
殺了它們！快殺了它們！！！

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
Kill! Kill them already!!!
scripts.translation:
[線材商人]
殺了它們！快殺了它們！！！

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
What am I to do?
Kill! Kill them already!!!
Are you here to help me?
scripts.translation:
[線材商人]
我該怎麼辦？
殺了它們！快殺了它們！！！
你是來幫我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
Kill! Kill them already!!!
Are you here to help me?
scripts.translation:
[線材商人]
殺了它們！快殺了它們！！！
你是來幫我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
What am I to do?
Are you here to help me?
scripts.translation:
[線材商人]
我該怎麼辦？
你是來幫我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
Are you here to help me?
scripts.translation:
[線材商人]
你是來幫我的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
Oh thank the Gods!
If you can only just kill the bugs I would be able to make my delivery.
scripts.translation:
[線材商人]
感謝神明！
如果你能幫我把那些蟲子殺掉，我就能完成送貨了。

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
Oh NO! Here they come!!
scripts.translation:
[線材商人]
啊不！它們來了！！

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
Thank you for killing the Thief Bugs.
As a token of my gratitude here is a box full of ^8080FFThread^000000.
scripts.translation:
[線材商人]
謝謝你消滅了那些浮勒盜蟲。
這一箱^8080FF線材^000000就送給你，當作謝禮。

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
Thank you again!
scripts.translation:
[線材商人]
再次感謝！

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
What to do...
scripts.translation:
[線材商人]
該怎麼辦呢...
